answer: Peers drawn from a pool the worker cannot see re-execute each claimed task and compare outputs field by field before the payout clears, and a mismatch slashes the worker's stake. Rendering work suits this because a pigment histogram and a vertex count are cheap to verify, so a farm of 1,000 identities must keep 1,000 real renders running past every horizon, which costs more compute than one honest job earns.
